title: Who Can See This Variable? — Local vs. Global Scope

responses.videoreflect: It made it clearer what global variable is and how to notice one when creating a function. It was able to show me step by step through visuals. It well put and is able to show you where you spot each parameter and local variables.
responses.strategy: To check whether a function is a parameter, a local variable, or a global variable is their placement around the function. The parameter would be next to the function in between parenthesis, local variable would be in the body of the function while global will be outside the function.
responses.clue: If a function, I see has no name I don't recognize I first look to see if it's in between parenthesis that will tell me whether its a parameter now if it's not, I will look inside the function and outside the function which will show the global and local variable.
